limits.maxMinutesReason: Phase 15 ruling 6 (code review 1 m3): at least 5 minutes above the harness's own waits (Phase 14 ruling 34). Worst case with every wait at its bound: setup about 3 s (window 2) + preflight 60 s (6 GETs, 10 s timeout) + 3 ecs describe-services reads 60 s (20 s subprocess timeout each) + 600 s load + 30 s worker tail + 1,500 s post-observation + 20 s poller join + 90 s collection = 2,363 s, about 39.4 min, 5.6 min under 45
limits.plannedBreakdown: setup (terraform output, sts, secret) under 1 min; preflight seconds; 600 s load; 1,500 s post-observation; collection at most 90 s
limits.maxRequestsPerLevelReason: window 2 ran about 36 requests per second at concurrency 8, so 600 s is about 21,500 requests, above the 20,000 default cap
limits.abortScope: unchanged from exp-d-query-load-v1: per request kind, a sliding window within the level and the whole level; preflight GET of each path first
limits.exitCodes: 0 the level ran; 1 abort rule; 2 usage; 3 precondition or non-2xx preflight; 4 unexpected error. Collection never changes the exit code.
limits.awsCallsByHarness: read-only only: sts get-caller-identity, secretsmanager get-secret-value (API key, memory only), ecs describe-services, application-autoscaling describe-scaling-activities and describe-scaling-policies, cloudwatch describe-alarms, describe-alarm-history and get-metric-data; the collection calls are allowlisted in the harness (READ_ONLY_CALLS)
limits.cpuTargetIs: an experiment setting for window 3 (Phase 15 ruling 2), not a tuned production value; production default 60
limits.scaleChanges: none by the harness; Application Auto Scaling may move graph-evidence-api between 1 and 2 tasks (Terraform service_max_counts.graph_evidence_api = 2, cpu target 15, scale-out cooldown 60 s, scale-in cooldown 120 s)
limits.budgetNote: incremental cost of the run only (one extra Fargate task for at most about 25 minutes, ALB requests, Neptune I/O, about 9 CloudWatch metric series in one get-metric-data call); the window's runtime hours are counted in the window 3 budget (ruling 3)
